purpose: Define the local Palmer breeding-site network and true-island subset before opening APBP abundance outcomes for the expanded network.
rationale: The radius contains all three Palmer Penguins field sites while remaining a local breeding neighborhood exposed to broadly shared regional marine forcing.
Site inclusion is based only on coordinates and landform identity, not abundance trajectories.
Biscoe Point is retained as a non-island breeding-site benchmark but excluded from the primary true-island subset.
stage1_outputs: all APBP breeding sites within 20 km of Palmer Station
stage2_rule: Freeze true-island membership from names/gazetteer evidence before exporting penguin_obs for the expanded network.

scientific_role.primary: true Palmer Archipelago islands as replicated breeding habitat patches
scientific_role.benchmark: Biscoe Point as a non-island Anvers breeding site with documented gentoo colonization
